mechanism_narrative: The continuing rise in WORKPLACES mobility signals more commuting and midday city activity, which translates into higher retail and recreation visits over the next four weeks as people combine work trips with discretionary stops.
evidence_refs: fact:WORKPLACES improved from -41.3 to -35.1 over the last three weeks
failure_condition: If RETAIL_REC does not rise over the next 28 days while WORKPLACES remains above its t-2w level, this mechanism is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A further improvement in TRANSIT mobility acts as a short-lag leading indicator of downtown access; once transit use stops being deeply depressed, retail and recreation mobility increases within the next one to two weeks.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT rises above its t-2w weekly mean and improves for two consecutive weeks
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT moved from -67.6 to -62.7 across t-2w to t-0w
failure_condition: If RETAIL_REC stays flat or falls over the following 14 days after TRANSIT crosses above its prior two-week mean, the hypothesis fails.

mechanism_narrative: When both GROCERY_PHARM and RESIDENTIAL are elevated together, routine neighborhood movement concentrates close to home and spills into nearby retail trips, producing a modest retail rebound over the next four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:GROCERY_PHARM improved from -15.4 to -6.9 while RESIDENTIAL stayed positive
failure_condition: If RETAIL_REC does not increase over 28 days despite GROCERY_PHARM remaining less negative than -10 and RESIDENTIAL staying above 15, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A renewed drop in PARKS mobility reflects tighter activity suppression or weather discouragement, and that same constraint reduces discretionary outings to retail and recreation over the following month.
candidate_trigger: PARKS falls below -45 week-on-week after having improved the prior week
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS was -50.6 at t-2w and -39.9 at t-0w
failure_condition: If RETAIL_REC rises over the next 28 days while PARKS falls below -45, then the restriction-linked spillover claim is false.

mechanism_narrative: If WORKPLACES and TRANSIT both keep improving together, the same commuters will generate a stronger weekday footfall cycle that lifts retail and recreation mobility within one week and sustains it through four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:both series improved from t-2w to t-0w
failure_condition: If RETAIL_REC does not increase within 7 days when both WORKPLACES and TRANSIT improve simultaneously, the interaction mechanism is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in PARKS mobility after a short rebound indicates fewer leisure excursions and weaker destination diversity, which then suppresses discretionary retail visits over the next two weeks.
candidate_trigger: PARKS turns downward for two consecutive weeks after a temporary increase
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS moved -50.6 to -41.3 to -39.9, then failed to recover further
failure_condition: If RETAIL_REC rises or remains above its last-four-week mean despite a two-week PARKS downturn, the hypothesis is not supported.

mechanism_narrative: When TRANSIT remains severely depressed below -60 while WORKPLACES is still below -30, access friction persists and retail activity continues to lag, keeping RETAIL_REC lower over the next four weeks.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT stays below -60 and WORKPLACES stays below -30 for at least one week
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT was -62.7 and WORKPLACES was -35.1 at t-0w
failure_condition: If RETAIL_REC increases over the next 28 days while both TRANSIT and WORKPLACES remain below the stated thresholds, the mechanism fails.

mechanism_narrative: As GROCERY_PHARM approaches baseline, essential trips normalize and spill over into nearby convenience retail, but only in the first week after the crossing; this should lift retail and recreation mobility briefly before fading.
candidate_trigger: GROCERY_PHARM rises above -10 after being below -10 in the prior week
evidence_refs: fact:GROCERY_PHARM improved from -15.3 to -6.9 over the snapshot
failure_condition: If RETAIL_REC does not improve within 7 days after GROCERY_PHARM crosses above -10, the hypothesis is rejected.
